Why do you pee your pants after having a baby ? Elvie Trainer is here to help. Watch for a quick breakdown! 70% of expectant and new mums experience some degree of Pelvic Floor Dysfunction and Elvie Trainer can help. The pelvic floor is a set of muscles that sit like a hammock in our pelvis, supporting many internal organs including the bladder - and ultimately if the muscles are not strong enough, they are unable to do their job. Including the tightening and relaxing of sphincter muscles to stop the flow of urine. Our pelvic floor hates us because we carry the extra weight of the baby, fluid and placenta on our pelvic floor like a bowl of oranges for months. After birth, these muscles can be weak and they need some focused strengthening. To do that - physical therapy, kegels, yoga, ab/core exercises, breathing exercises, AND this super-cool biofeedback device - Elvie Trainer. Elvie Trainer uses special sensors to record info about how your muscles are working AS you do pelvic floor movements. Kegels never work for me because I don’t know if I’m doing them right (most people are NOT in fact doing them right). This allows you to ‘visualize’ the movements and get feedback so you can perform the pelvic floor exercises the right way. Watch for a quick breakdown! 70% of expectant and new mums experience some degree of Pelvic Floor Dysfunction and Elvie Trainer can help. The pelvic floor is a set of muscles that sit like a hammock in our pelvis, supporting many internal organs including the bladder - and ultimately if the muscles are not strong enough, they are unable to do their job. Including the tightening and relaxing of sphincter muscles to stop the flow of urine. Our pelvic floor hates us because we carry the extra weight of the baby, fluid and placenta on our pelvic floor like a bowl of oranges for months. After birth, these muscles can be weak and they need some focused strengthening. To do that - physical therapy, kegels, yoga, ab/core exercises, breathing exercises, AND this super-cool biofeedback device - Elvie Trainer. Elvie Trainer uses special sensors to record info about how your muscles are working AS you do pelvic floor movements. Kegels never work for me because I don’t know if I’m doing them right (most people are NOT in fact doing them right). This allows you to ‘visualize’ the movements and get feedback so you can perform the pelvic floor exercises the right way. "I feel like I had to post these as my journey was so short through no fault of my own but I do treasure these moments and glad I could give him not only his first feed from me and the most important feeds too! For those who didn't know (short version) I developed Extensive Cerebral Venous Sinus Thrombosis - CVST is a rare form of stroke which affects about 5 people in 1 million each year. Aswell as stage two Papilledema - swelling of both optic discs in your eyes due to increased intracranial pressure. I had symptom from around a day postpartum, I told my midwife on two different occasions and was fobbed off so I put it down to dehydration headache, then cluster headaches and a few other things in between, basically I felt and looked like I was dying, my migraines where way worse than normal - I'd had them as long as I can remember but got worse last couple months of pregnancy - my left eye wouldn't stop streaming, it was only archies 5 day appointment that I got taken seriously and rushed for an MRI which came back with the CVST and stage one, which went to stage two the next day Papilledema. I was transfered to the Stroke Ward and stayed there for two weeks, thankfully with Archie and Daryl(my family and friends where amazing at this time making lexi and Freddies Christmas as normal as possible for them!) but I was on that many different trails of meditation - most knocking me out causing me to sleep 90% of the day/night so BF was put on hold, by the end I was told because of the medication I was on at the time that if I continued to BF I'd apparently need to get my bloods and other tests weekly which wasn't really practical trying to work around school, baby and still constant migraines so that drew the end to my journey."-Inspiring journey shared by @amyjaddewright_. #Momcozy #BeAcozyMom #WorldBreastfeedingWeek2024 #WBW2024 #breastfeedingawareness #breastfeedingmama #breastfeedingquotes #breastfeedinghumor #breastfeedinglife #momlife #babyfeeding #breastfed
